title: Bundle Household Relief on Parking License Reinstatement for Storage Rental Holders
content:
Bundle program terms: a household that also rents storage receives bundle household relief on the Parking License reinstatement fee, larger when the Storage Rental has run a year or more.

## Terms

When the lease holds an active storage rental that started at least 365 days before the handling date, the bundle household relief is $10.00; when the lease holds an active storage rental that started fewer than 365 days before the handling date, the bundle household relief is $5.00; in every other case there is no bundle household relief. The bundle household relief is subtracted from the reinstatement fee, and the reinstatement fee is never below zero.

The storage rental read is the lease's Storage Rental in active status, and its start date is counted in days to the handling date.

## Relief by Storage Rental

| Active Storage Rental on the lease | Started before the handling date | Bundle household relief |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 365 days or more | $10.00 |
| yes | fewer than 365 days | $5.00 |
| no | — | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical rentals)

- Active Storage Rental started 365 days before the handling date: $10.00.
- Started 364 days before: $5.00.
- A Storage Rental that has ended, and no other active one on the lease: none.
